evidence.ref: Historical record reader: node scripts/design-surface-census.mjs --retained pricing. Retained records are source-local history with unclassified distribution; archive integrity is not current certification or permission to publish screenshots. Prior reference text retained for provenance: docs/screenshots/pricing-recert-1029/README.md. Renewed 2026-10-31 (PR #23964, rebased after #23954): the Artist Presence card now lists the features it adds over Free (derived from the comparison data), and two comparison row labels were renamed (Audience email capture, Release notifications to your audience); same markup and classes, no layout change. Verified by pricing unit tests only (MarketingPricingPlans, PricingComparisonChart, PricingRecipeBody, copy-rendered-verification); the pricing e2e and 1440/390 overflow check were not run locally and are left to CI. Main-red renewal: #23600 added a copy-allow comment around the copyright line in MarketingFooter.tsx (a /pricing owner); rendered DOM and layout unchanged. Pricing e2e 11/11 on current main, no horizontal overflow at 1440 or 390. Prior: docs/screenshots/mvp-pricing-audit-1029/README.md. PR #23570 replaced the false comparison row (fan capture capped at 100 on Free) with true certified rows; layout unchanged; pricing e2e 11/11 at 320-1440, no horizontal overflow at 1440 and 390. Merged with PR #23618 (main): its shared stylesheet change touches only .system-b-artist-notifications-card-* and the mobile .system-b-launch-profile-stage rule, which match no /pricing elements. Main Renewed 2026-10-29 (PR #23597 rebase onto #23618): MarketingHero dropped its unused photo prop and photo-only classes; content-mode DOM and classes are unchanged (MarketingHero.test.tsx). Renewed 2026-10-31 (PR #23954): PublicPageShell gained optional pageContract and footerShowCta props, MarketingHeader now reads the homepage CTA from data/marketing/headerCta.ts; only the (home) layout passes them, so /pricing rendered DOM is unchanged (defaults preserved; PublicPageShell, MarketingHeader and MarketingFooter unit tests green). Renewed 2026-10-31 (PR #24036): MarketingHeader and MarketingFooter read the pathname through usePublicPathname instead of usePathname so server and client markup agree; rendered DOM and classes on /pricing are unchanged (MarketingFooter and PublicPageShell unit tests green). Found by the merge-group census failure in run 41230243515. Renewed 2026-11-01 (PR #23611 rebase onto main): ArtistProfileLandingPage.css changed only .ap-how-it-works__setup-stage-header/-detail grid tracks after the step numeral was removed; no /pricing element uses those classes, so /pricing DOM and layout are unchanged. Renewed 2026-11-01 (PR #23606 rebase onto main after #23611): plan cards drop the eyebrow badge, one closing CTA, category rows lose mono caps, comparison rows stay the certified public set passed server-side; verified by hosted CI pricing unit and e2e lanes, production screenshots at 1440 and 390 after deploy. Same day: the comparison chart reads the certified row set directly again (no server prop), restoring main client chunking; markup unchanged. Same day (PR #23606 review fix): the plans-section padding-top rule moved after the section padding-block rules so it applies; only .system-b-pricing-section--plans changes. Renewed 2026-11-02 (JOV-10350): balanced mobile comparison columns and allowed full desktop feature labels to wrap. Exact local Chromium pricing suite 11/11 passes at 320–1440 in both motion modes, including strict painted-text containment, keyboard navigation, and accessibility; 33 pricing/copy unit tests pass. Keyboard assertions follow the single paid closing CTA established by #23606 and verify its destination. Local source certification only; production verification remains pending. Evidence: docs/screenshots/pricing-recert-1102/README.md. Desktop descriptions carry the existing explicit feature-label row contract; the unchanged locked column-heading detector passes (2 tests), and the full 11-test pricing browser suite passes again after that declaration. Renewed 2026-11-05 (PR #24271, merge-group run 42118741966): MarketingHeader.tsx - a /pricing certification owner - now selects the named 28px marketing brand mark (Tim logo-28 directive 2026-11-02, BRAND_MARK_SIZE.marketing); the /pricing page and every other owner file are byte-identical to the certified state, and the only rendered /pricing change is the header brand mark size 20px to 28px (asserted by the MarketingHeader route tests). Digest recomputed on the PR head tree; design:authority:check green locally. Renewed 2026-11-08 (PR #24492, merge-group run 42451431307): ArtistProfileLandingPage.css, a /pricing owner, sets the plan card radius to var(--radius-none). The plans already render as one joined panel (1px gap divider, panel radius with overflow hidden), so the only rendered /pricing change is that the inner joins between plan cards are square instead of showing notches; outer corners, markup and classes are unchanged (asserted by pricing-plans-padding-order.test.ts). The /pricing page and every other owner file are byte-identical to the certified state. Digest recomputed on the PR head tree; design:authority:check green locally. Renewed 2026-11-08 (homepage v3 port): MarketingFooter gained optional penSection and decoration props, PublicPageShell gained optional footerPenSection, footerDecoration, headerHidePrimaryCta and headerLeftWordmark props, and MarketingHeader gained optional hidePrimaryCta and leftWordmark props (all default off); only the (home) layout passes them, so /pricing rendered DOM is unchanged (MarketingFooter, PublicPageShell and header unit tests green). Digest recomputed on the PR head tree. Renewed 2026-11-08 (homepage v3 port): MarketingFooter gained optional penSection and decoration props, PublicPageShell gained optional footerPenSection, footerDecoration, headerHidePrimaryCta and headerLeftWordmark props, and MarketingHeader gained optional hidePrimaryCta and leftWordmark props (all default off); only the (home) layout passes them, so /pricing rendered DOM is unchanged (MarketingFooter, PublicPageShell and header unit tests green). Digest recomputed on the PR head tree. Same PR: MarketingHeader renders the mark with its reveal wordmark when leftWordmark is set; only the (home) layout sets it, so /pricing is unchanged. Renewed 2026-11-09 (PR #24695): pricing metadata and JSON-LD name now use Pricing | Jovie; rendered components and styles are unchanged. Chromium rendered the source/owner tree at 6b5ff3996f1682fe08116a08be230d085cd43010 at 1440px and 390px: HTTP 200 at /pricing, no horizontal overflow or page errors. Capture records and full-page screenshots: docs/screenshots/pricing-recert-1109/ (pruned 2026-11-16, see below). Source-local evidence only; not deployment proof. Pruned 2026-11-16 (byte-budget headroom): the historical capture binaries under docs/screenshots/jov-8097/, pricing-recert-1029/, pricing-recert-1102/ and pricing-recert-1109/ (2,638,336 bytes of PNG/JPG captures plus their small READMEs) were deleted; no /pricing source or owner file changed and the rendered surface is unchanged since the 2026-11-09 renewal. Capture records preserved in git history at f2b0ec53f1. The 2026-10-15 transition event's evidence pointer names jov-8097/README.md and is kept byte-identical (transition history is append-only). Retention follow-through for PR #25871 (merged 2026-11-17): 15 retained files total 2,638,336 bytes, comprising 2,628,253 image bytes and 10,083 metadata bytes. The original November 9 capture manifest records its source binding and image digests; earlier README-only bundles remain legacy records without equivalent capture bindings.
